name: @chatbridge/vscode
description: VSCode extension factory for chatbridge: a sidebar chat view on top of ChatSession

scripts.build:webview: esbuild src/webview/main.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/webview/main.js && mkdir -p dist/webview && cp src/webview/style.css dist/webview/style.css
